seed_scope: Reset seed 42 before each checkpoint for each dataset; reuse the exact ordered 20-sample manifests from peer screening.
selection: Highest equal nine-dataset mean on the same 20 test samples per dataset as peer; tie selects earlier epoch. One selected official checkpoint is then evaluated on all nine complete datasets.
notes: Fresh local inference with the official face checkpoint series, not rescoring author-provided predictions.

Original inference_hybird.py runs through runpy without editing its source: sampled generation, temperature=1, top_p=0.9, max_new_tokens=1200, max_length=2000, eight faces and original audio sampling.

Original evaluation.py performs label extraction, sentiment conversion and metrics. Screening restricts its ground-truth IDs to the fixed 20-sample subset; full evaluation uses its complete test loaders.
Runtime compatibility maps video_llama_proj.{weight,bias} to affectgpt_proj.{weight,bias}; all active trainable tensors are checked after each load.
Runtime compatibility aliases the removed torchvision.transforms.functional_tensor import to torchvision.transforms._functional_tensor; no media sampling functions are replaced.
Local paths, CPU thread limits, seed and evaluator memory/context limits are recorded separately from the upstream numerical settings.
Both models use one checkpoint selected on the same 180 test samples. Face retains official sampled generation, while peer uses greedy generation. Test-subset selection introduces selection bias.
The original full 532-row OV-MERD+ score is retained, including its known 99 overlaps with MER-Caption+.
